My invited contributions span atomic and molecular physics, plasma diagnostics, machine learning, quantum science, and plasma-based technologies. The record below includes conference presentations, faculty development sessions, and instructional lectures and tutorials.

Dates indicate the event period where an individual presentation date is not specified.
